name: wave_rover
description: Target rover: Waveshare WAVE ROVER chassis + Jetson Orin Nano Super + one RGB camera (about USD 365 all in). Camera height, clearance and step limit are the values stated in the SIH26126 presentation.
notes: height_above_ground_m, clearance_m and max_step_m are the presentation's stated settings.
hfov_deg and pitch_deg must be replaced by the calibrated values of the camera actually mounted.
width_m / length_m are carried over from rc_pov; measure the chassis with the camera mount fitted.
max_speed_mps / brake_distance_m are a deliberately low first-trial limit, to be raised only after a measured brake test.
